(Brooklyn, New York) | college = [[Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball|Seton Hall]] (2014–2016) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *[[Haggerty Award]] (2016) *First-team All-[[Big East Conference|Big East]] (2016) *Big East All-Rookie team (2015) *[[Big East Men's Basketball Tournament|Big East Tournament]] MOP ([[2016 Big East Men's Basketball Tournament|2016]]) *[[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2014 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2014]]) *[[Jordan Brand Classic]] selection (2014) *[[Parade All-America Boys Basketball Team|''Parade'' All-American]] (2014) *[[Mr. New York Basketball]] (2014) | medal_templates = }} '''Isaiah Whitehead''' (born March 8, 1995) is an American [[basketball]] player who played his college career for the [[Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball]] team. == High school career == He rose to prominence playing for [[Abraham Lincoln High School (Brooklyn)|Abraham Lincoln High School]], and was a highly touted recruit coming into college. Whitehead played at the [[2014 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]], the 2014 [[Jordan Brand Classic]], and many other prestigious tournaments in high school. He was labeled a five-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]] and [[247Sports.com]], being named [[Mr. New York Basketball]], the recipient of the PSAL 2014 Wingate Award, Co-Most Valuable Player in the 2013 Under Armour Elite 24 game, and the highest-rated New York City recruit since 2009.{{cite web|title=Isaiah Whitehead Bio|url=http://www.shupirates.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/isaiah_whitehead_911979.html|website=SHUPirates.com|accessdate=1 October 2014}} ==College career== Whitehead was named preseason Big East Rookie of the Year and made the All-Rookie Team as a freshman. He was twice selected as Rookie of the Week on December 15 and December 8. He did not play in nine games due to stress fracture. At the conclusion of the 2015-16 regular season, he was unanimously selected to the First Team All-Big East.{{cite news|title=Four Named Unanimously to MBB All-BIG EAST First Team|url=http://www.bigeast.com/news/2016/3/6/MBB_0306160917.aspx|accessdate=March 9, 2015|work=[[Big East Conference]]|date=March 6, 2015}} He also received the [[Haggerty Award]], given to the New York area's top men's Division I basketball player.[http://www.app.com/story/sports/college/2016/04/12/seton-halls-whitehead-wins-haggerty-award/82924738/ Seton Hall's Whitehead wins Haggerty Award] ==Professional career== Whitehead would enter the newly-formed college deadline as one of 59 different college students to enter the [[2016 NBA Draft]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.shupirates.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/isaiah_whitehead_911979.html Seton Hall Pirates bio] {{Haggerty Award}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Whitehead, Isaiah}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from New York]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Parade High School All-Americans (boys' basketball)]] [[Category:Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Brooklyn]]
